_comment: Authored, purpose-implying prop clusters (bible sec2 P3: do not dump props everywhere). Structures from the Quaternius Fantasy Props MegaKit (docs/ASSET_LEDGER.md), placed by scripts/world/props.gd: each entry is stood on the ground by asking the world (D09), given a box collider from its combined mesh AABB, and scaled by its own `scale` -- the pack is authored close to real-world size so most entries sit near 1.0. ALL TUNABLE.
_comment_layout: work_area sits south-west of the village square's Barn [2,2] -- a smithing/repair nook implying someone maintains the settlement's tools, far enough from the Barn's own footprint and the Quarry Foreman NPC [0,-6] to read as its own spot rather than clutter. farmhouse_yard sits south of Grandpa's house [-22,-16] -- storage and harvest overflow for a farm that feeds itself. Grandpa's house is a real footprint, not just its terrain pad (grandpa_house.gd: INNER_W 9.0/INNER_D 7.0/WALL_T 0.3 -> half_w 4.8, half_d 3.8, so the house's own south wall sits at z=-19.8) -- an earlier placement here landed props inside that wall; kept 4m+ clear of it now, and still off the house's east-facing door lane (tested by smoke_opening, x -16..-9.7 at z~-15).
